page.overview:
Who is Dr. Woo?

Dr. Woo was a famous scholar and scientist before being abducted by the Secret Society. From there, he developed various biological weapons based on Urien's theories about the remodeling of the human body, which resulted in the creation of Eleven and Twelve plus the surgery of Necro's body. Despite being their captive, he enjoys the work given to him. He also claims to have an IQ over 1300.
